title: Chat interface with local echo replies
when: The user wants a chat screen with message bubbles, an input bar and replies, working offline with a local echo or scripted bot and no server.
prompt:
Goal: A chat screen that feels real on a phone, keeps the input visible and renders every message as text.
Steps:
1. Message { id, author: me | bot, text, at }; logic.mjs: createMessage, replyFor(text) from a rules table with an echo fallback, groupByDay, formatTime.
2. Layout: header, a scrolling list with role="log" and aria-live="polite", and a bottom form with a labeled textarea and Send; height 100dvh.
3. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line; ignore empty text; keep focus in the textarea.
4. Bubbles: mine right with the accent, others left; text via textContent with white-space: pre-wrap.
5. Typing indicator for 600 to 1200 ms before a reply; scroll down only if the user was already near the bottom.
6. Keep the last 200 messages in localStorage chat.v1 guarded; Clear chat with confirm.
7. test.mjs: replyFor rules, empty rejected, groupByDay.
Quality bar:
- Mobile keyboard never hides the input.
- Date separators between days.
- Long words wrap.
Pitfalls:
- innerHTML for message text.
- Jumping to the bottom while the user reads history.
- Pretending to send to a server.
Verify:
- [ ] Log has role="log".
- [ ] Textarea labeled.
- [ ] History reloads.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (messages and bot rules), test.mjs.

examples.input: a chat interface for a support bot demo
examples.output: bubbles, typing dots, bot answers "hours" and "price", echo fallback, history saved
